csv_scope_of_work: Santa Barbara city may be seeking a consultant to provide design service for State Street Improvement - Upon the completion of the State Street Master Plan, the City will implement a number of capital improvement projects over a 10-20 year planning period. State Street Design Services include construction level design and project management for each project phase, including detailed design work so that the vision of the State Street Master Plan can be realized. The project includes design services for areas in the State Street Master Plan with a location of State Street from Sola Street to the 101 underpass and Chapala to Anacapa Streets.
